content.text: {"conditions":{"rc1":{"status":"gap","note":"The record ends with the bare statement that 'the Agency concluded that Complainant failed to prove' discrimination, with no stated reasoning linking the documented evidence to that conclusion. The evidence also cuts the other way at key points: unanswered reassignment requests, an FOHS opinion revised the next day, and an admission that Complainant 'was successfully performing such functions' from Florida."},"rc2":{"status":"review","note":"Many characterizations are tied to identified sources, such as dated emails, FOHS letters, signed evaluations and the Supplemental ROI at 115-24. Others are not: RMO1's low-productivity claim rests on unspecified 'research' of the track record, RMO2's testimony was hearsay, and the 'individual assessment' is only said to be what 'may have been' the FOHS review."},"rc3":{"status":"review","note":"Most Claim 1 events are dated in sequence from September 27, 2016 through August 16, 2017. Gaps remain: the original accommodation is dated only 'late 2010 or early 2011', the PIP dates are absent, and the FY 2015 evaluation is missing. Whether telework was two days or full-time is unclear, and RMO6's 'August 2018' testimony post-dates the February 23, 2018 FAD request without any explanation of the investigative timeline."},"rc4":{"status":"gap","note":"The claims being adjudicated are never stated, the FAD decision-maker and the legal standards applied are not identified, and the denial rationale shifts between undue hardship (RMO4's December 2017 affidavit) and essential functions. The 'seven of nineteen' essential functions are listed as six numbered items plus unnumbered text, and the investigator says RMO6 was not contacted yet RMO6's testimony appears, so it cannot be shown that Complainant's rebuttals and suggested alternatives were weighed."},"rc5":{"status":"gap","note":"Given the unexplained FAD conclusion, the undefined claims, the missing FY 2015 evaluation, the contradictions over RMO6's testimony and the undue-hardship rationale, and the unresolved telework history, an independent reviewer could not assess from this record alone whether the conclusion is supported."}}}
